name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Replaces lossy compaction summary with Fast Jev & RLCD decisions (Laya or Jev): scores tool calls/results, drops stale items, preserves verbatim history, with Laya fallback.
author: Aurapunk IDE / tamaratran / NandhaKishorM

provider.description: Classifier provider: 'auto' (Jev with Laya fallback), 'jev', or 'laya'

keepThreshold.description: Minimum keep probability threshold for retaining tool calls/results

preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of most recent messages to keep completely untouched

truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a dropped tool result retained before truncation note

maxStateTokens.description: Maximum estimated tokens allowed for the classifier state
